profile.headline: Software Engineer III at Frost Bank
profile.summary: Through my education and personal projects, I've been exposed to everything from machine language to frameworks. The language I feel most confident in is NodeJS, my most recent projects have been developed using this. Java is the language I studied in college and have experience with it. HTML 5, CSS 3, and Javascript are also languages I’m confident in because I built the front end of a mobile application using them. The APIs and tools I feel the most comfortable using are ReactJS, Express, Angular 4, JDBC and Hibernate 4.0. I have also acquired knowledge of using Spring 4.2 and Web Services. I have a background in full life-cycle of software development process including requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, debugging and maintenance. I enjoy challenges and working on projects that require me to work outside of my comfort zone and knowledge set, as continuing to learn new languages and development techniques are important to me and the success of your organization. I consider myself to be a results-oriented, dependable, and capable worker. Also, I am fluent in Spanish.
